title: DialogueVPR: Towards Conversational Visual Place Recognition
description:
arXiv:2607.14115v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Inspired by how humans communicate spatial information, language-guided geo-localization has gained significant traction for its intuitive and practical value. Despite this progress, most methods still rely on a static, one-shot retrieval paradigm, which fails to handle the ambiguity and incompleteness inherent in real-world natural language descriptions.
